name: 20 Bucks Is 20 Bucks: A Never-Ending Story
source:
Twenty bucks pass from one unfamiliar character to another.
The circle is complete, the twenty bucks return to the first character, and the cycle begins again.
With each new circle, a new choice is added. Twenty bucks pass from one unfamiliar character to another.
